description.value: Wilson Creek Linear Park is a nature reserve and linear greenway managed by the City of Kelowna in British Columbia. As a linear park, it likely follows a creek corridor and offers a natural off-road passage through the community. Touring cyclists passing through Kelowna may find it a pleasant, low-traffic route or rest stop along their journey.
